Name: Lan Yan
Desc: A rattan weaver from Chenyu Vale. Clear-minded and well-tempered, she is as lively as a mountain spring.

Skills.Name: Normal Attack: Black Pheasant Strides on Water
Skills.Desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Wields her ring blades and performs up to 4 attacks using them, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to throw out a ring blade, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

Skills.Name: Phoenix-Wisp Pinion Dance
Skills.Desc: Summoning forth the Phoenix-Wisp Shield, a secret art passed down across generations, Lan Yan dashes forward and, upon making contact with her target, will leap back into the air. The Phoenix-Wisp Shield's DMG absorption scales based on her ATK, and has a 250% absorption efficiency against Anemo DMG. While in mid-air due to the effects of her Elemental Skill, pressing her Elemental Skill again or pressing Normal Attack will cause Lan Yan to hurl her Feathermoon Rings at an opponent, and they will spin between nearby opponents twice upon hit, dealing Anemo DMG. Holding the Skill will cause it to behave differently. Hold Enter Aiming Mode to adjust the dash direction. "The clouds cut the lunar light, like shadows silver gracing one's sight."

Skills.Name: Lustrous Moonrise
Skills.Desc: Lan Yan creates a Feathermoon Swallow Array, pulling in nearby opponents and objects and dealing multiple instances of AoE Anemo DMG.\n\nStrictly speaking, with only Lan Yan herself present, it cannot properly be called an "array." However, if her Rattan Figures are brought into the picture, she can sort of fulfill the requirements ...Probably.

Passives.Name: Four Sealing Divination Blades
Passives.Desc: When the dash from the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Phoenix-Wisp Pinion Dance</color> hits an opponent, if it interacts with <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>/<color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>/<color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>/<color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>, the Phoenix-Wisp Shield will undergo Elemental Conversion, with the converted shield absorbing DMG from the corresponding element with 250% efficiency.\nAdditionally, if this use of <color=#FFD780FF>Phoenix-Wisp Pinion Dance</color> causes the Phoenix-Wisp Shield to undergo Elemental Conversion, the Feathermoon Rings that Lan Yan throws at her foes additionally deal Elemental DMG equal to 50% of the original in the corresponding Elemental Type. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

Passives.Name: Skyfeather Evil-Subduing Charm
Passives.Desc: The Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Phoenix-Wisp Pinion Dance</color> and the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Lustrous Moonrise</color> deal increased DMG equal to 309% and 774% of Lan Yan's Elemental Mastery respectively.

Constellations.Name: "As One Might Stride Betwixt the Clouds"
Constellations.Desc: After triggering the Elemental Conversion from the Passive Talent "Four Sealing Divination Blades," this instance of Lan Yan's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Phoenix-Wisp Pinion Dance</color> will produce another Feathermoon Ring when they are thrown at opponents.\nYou must first unlock the Passive Talent "Four Sealing Divination Blades."

Constellations.Name: "Dance Vestments Billow Like Rainbow Jade"
Constellations.Desc: While the <color=#FFD780FF>Phoenix-Wisp Shield</color> is active, when your active party member's Normal Attacks deal DMG, 40% of the Shield's DMG absorption will be restored, up to its original maximum absorption. This effect can occur once every 2s.

Constellations.Name: "On White Wings Pierce Through Cloud and Fog"
Constellations.Desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Phoenix-Wisp Pinion Dance</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

Constellations.Name: "With Drakefalcon's Blood-Pearls Adorned"
Constellations.Desc: After Lan Yan uses her Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Lustrous Moonrise</color>, the Elemental Mastery of all nearby party members increases by 60 for 12s.

Constellations.Name: "Having Met You, My Heart is Gladdened"
Constellations.Desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Lustrous Moonrise</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

Constellations.Name: "Let Us Away on Slyphic Wing, the Silvered Ornaments to Ring"
